provenance.title: BPS states, knots and quivers
provenance.authors: Piotr Kucharski1, Markus Reineke2, Marko Stoˇsić3,4, and Piotr Su lkowski1,5

candidates.statement: By standard arguments [4, 14, 15], BPS states in brane systems – in particular those describing knots – should have a description in terms of supersymmetric quantum mechanics on their world-volume, which however has not been identiﬁed to date.

In this letter we argue that BPS states enumerated by motivic Donaldson-Thomas invariants of quiver mod- uli spaces should be identiﬁed with those arising in the supersymmetric quiver quantum mechanics description of brane systems encoding knots.

Moreover, as predicted in [@Kontsevich:2010px], the Cohomological Hall Algebra associated to a quiver should be identified as the algebra of BPS states [@Harvey:1996gc], which deserves further studies in the context of brane realization of knot invariants.
candidates.section_title: Knot invariants from quiver representation theory

candidates.statement: It is natural to expect that various properties, well known on one side of the duality, should have their counterparts on the other side.
We expect that analogous objects should exist for quivers, presumably generalizing observations in [@COM:8276935].

On the other hand, various properties of quivers, their moduli spaces, and other related objects -- in particular Cohomological Hall Algebra -- should shed new light on properties of knot invariants, in particular knot homologies.
